title: Skill Generator Plan Schema
description: Discovered project metadata for skill generation. Output by plan-skill-generator, consumed by run-skill-generator-execute.

unit_path.description: Relative path to the unit root (usually '.' for a single-project repo). Absolute paths discouraged for portability.

unit_type.description: High-level project type determines driver pattern and launch approach.

detected_technologies.description: Technologies/frameworks found: 'react', 'vite', 'node', 'electron', 'python', etc. Helps choose driver templates.

build_system.description: Primary build/package manager. 'none' if the project doesn't require building.

test_framework.description: Test runner if detected: 'vitest', 'jest', 'pytest', 'cargo test', 'bats', etc. Null if not found.

launch_method.description: How the project is typically launched. Determines driver entry point.

device_type.description: Does this run in a terminal (tty/headless), a GUI window (gui), or either (headless for web servers)?

key_findings.description: Human-readable observations about the project. Bullet points, not prose.

potential_issues.description: Gotchas discovered during discovery: missing dependencies, platform limits, etc.

recommended_driver_pattern.description: Suggested driver approach. Informs which template to use.

confidence_level.description: 0.0–1.0 confidence in the analysis. High uncertainty when multiple build systems or ambiguous patterns detected.

files_scanned.description: Number of files examined during discovery.

patterns_matched.description: Number of recognized patterns (e.g., 'package.json exists', 'Dockerfile found').

discovery_time_ms.description: Milliseconds spent on discovery. Helps measure performance.

monorepo_hint.description: If unit_type is 'monorepo', this is a path hint for which app to target (e.g., 'apps/web' or 'packages/sdk'). Null if not a monorepo.

custom_notes.description: Any additional observations (e.g., 'Legacy codebase with custom build scripts', 'Requires Docker'). Optional.

key_findings: Rust CLI using clap for args
potential_issues: No GPU support in container (not needed)
